first_run_behavior: 191 phrase routes were assigned by substring rules to finance/calculator/private-house/P44/aluminium/veranda/door/model/accessory pages.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The candidate pages already existed and many tokens strongly hinted at a more specific destination.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: A matching token does not prove primary page role; 191 hidden exceptions are not an auditable site architecture and can confuse primary vs supporting destinations.
root_cause: Lexical evidence was promoted directly into structural truth without materializing the intermediate user-task subunit.
corrective_action: Replace runtime substring overrides with explicit named structural subunits containing task, all member phrases, page evidence, primary/supporting role and confidence.
verification_required: Final architecture has zero hidden runtime lexical overrides; every specialized route belongs to an explicit structural unit with auditable members/evidence.
notes: Must be fixed before final phrase map is rebuilt. | Closed only after V4 persistence/readback plus separate semantic acceptance; this does not imply Step12 final completion.

first_run_behavior: Some mixed clusters such as DIY installation, panoramic commercial, legal/permission, wood windows, hardware info and repair DIY received one structural action despite heterogeneous member tasks.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The first run did list every phrase, so the review looked complete and a dominant task was visible.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Listing members is not the same as proving coherence; a good-looking cluster label can still hide different objects, formats or terminal tasks.
root_cause: Phrase-level visibility was mistaken for phrase-level semantic validation.
corrective_action: Re-audit all known mixed units and any newly discovered ones; create explicit correction/subunit rows or unresolved rows before structural decisions.
verification_required: Known mixed units left uncorrected = 0; each moved phrase has a correction row and every final unit has one explainable terminal task/page expectation.

first_run_behavior: Five new pages were justified mostly by phrase count, narrative task stability, page gap and business fit without a dedicated demand/Search evidence table.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: Those are relevant signals and the project already had substantial upstream research.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Phrase count is not demand; standalone page boundaries may depend on actual frequency and Search result/page-type evidence. HIGH confidence was therefore not auditable.
root_cause: Existing Wordstat/Search evidence was not joined to the new-page decision at the point of acceptance.
corrective_action: Build STEP_12_NEW_PAGE_EVIDENCE.tsv for every surviving new-page candidate using persisted Wordstat and ordinary Search evidence first; use Bridge only for a named unresolved material gap after authorization.
verification_required: Every accepted new page has demand evidence, business truth, existing-page alternative review, relevant Search-boundary evidence or an explicit reason Search is not needed, plus an evidence-backed maturity/confidence.
notes: No new provider request is authorized by this ledger itself. | Closed/reclosed only after V5/V2 persisted readback and separate evidence acceptance; candidate page approval remains governed by later confidence/maturity.

first_run_behavior: The helper used confidence='HIGH' by default, so decisions became HIGH unless manually downgraded.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: Most rows had been reviewed and many page fits were clear, making HIGH feel like a convenient default.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Confidence then measured the absence of a manual downgrade rather than evidence strength and could erase upstream MEDIUM uncertainty.
root_cause: Confidence was treated as a presentation label instead of a derived evidence conclusion.
corrective_action: Remove default HIGH. Preserve explicit dimensions TASK_COHERENCE, BUSINESS_TRUTH, CURRENT_PAGE_FIT, DEMAND_SUPPORT, SEARCH_BOUNDARY_SUPPORT and HIERARCHY_CLARITY; derive final confidence/maturity and downgrade reason.
verification_required: No final action has confidence without populated evidence dimensions; missing material evidence cannot yield HIGH.
notes: Closed only after data readback, machine QA and manual challenge acceptance agreed: 160 units, zero rows without evidence dimensions, default HIGH false, and zero new-page HIGH rows with a material Search gap. This does not imply Step12 final completion.

first_run_behavior: Several QA fields were hard-coded 0/true, some checks only tested that text existed, and every SPLIT/MERGE was counted as an error rather than only unsupported ones.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The script was intended to enforce forbidden shortcuts and deterministic pass conditions.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: A constant does not verify reality; counting all SPLIT/MERGE as failures biases the result toward zero and makes legitimate actions impossible to validate.
root_cause: The same implementation that created the result also declared desired invariants instead of deriving them from independent evidence.
corrective_action: Rebuild QA with evidence origin for every field: COMPUTED_FROM_DATA, VERIFIED_FROM_PROVENANCE or MANUAL_REVIEW_LEDGER. SPLIT/MERGE QA must inspect support evidence per action.
verification_required: QA self-asserted pass fields = 0; unsupported split = 0; unsupported merge = 0; review-led semantic checks have explicit case rows.

first_run_behavior: Step-13 follow-up was manually flagged for selected clusters rather than generated from the complete final page-routing graph.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The obvious risky families were known and manual flags were fast to create.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: After phrase-level routing across parent/child/utility/model pages, less obvious page pairs can be missed; Step 13 would start from analyst memory rather than a complete candidate universe.
root_cause: Downstream handoff was designed before the final routing graph was fully exploited.
corrective_action: Generate STEP_12_STEP13_CANDIDATE_PAIRS.tsv from final structural units/page destinations, recording page A/B, adjacent task, member evidence, normal-overlap rationale and whether later direct Search check is needed.
verification_required: Candidate pair universe is deterministically derived from final routing; no cannibalization verdict appears in Step 12.
notes: Step 13 remains blocked until this is complete.

first_run_behavior: New pages had proposed slugs and broad parent labels but not concrete inbound/outbound internal-link and navigation plans.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The initial objective focused on deciding whether a page should exist, so a broad parent looked sufficient.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: A URL without a clear place in navigation is not a complete structural recommendation and may become orphaned or overlap with existing paths.
root_cause: Page existence was separated too sharply from page relationships.
corrective_action: Build STEP_12_HIERARCHY_PLAN.tsv for every accepted new/split page with parent URL/section, inbound link sources, anchor concept, outbound support links, commercial handoff and breadcrumb/navigation role.
verification_required: Accepted new/split pages without hierarchy plan = 0.
notes: Implemented artifact name is STEP_12_NEW_PAGE_HIERARCHY_PLAN.tsv rather than the provisional ledger filename; it satisfies the required schema/coverage. Closed only after 5/5 candidates had parent, inbound and outbound roles, orphan count 0, existing targets read back against Step01 inventory, and unresolved Search boundaries remained unresolved. This does not imply all five candidate pages are finally approved.

first_run_behavior: For some mixed groups we correctly rejected one generic standalone page but only wrote prose saying useful pieces should be distributed later.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: Rejecting a bad combined page was the most visible structural decision.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: NO_STANDALONE_PAGE answers only whether a new URL should exist; it does not answer where each useful user need will be served.
root_cause: Cluster-level rejection was incorrectly treated as completion of phrase-level routing.
corrective_action: For every no-page unit, route useful subparts to an existing page/section, create another explicit structural unit, defer with named missing evidence, or mark truly outside scope.
verification_required: Useful phrases stranded solely because their parent unit is NO_STANDALONE_PAGE = 0.
notes: Legal/permission group is a known example. | Closed only after V4 persistence/readback plus separate semantic acceptance; this does not imply Step12 final completion.

first_run_behavior: Valid in-scope phrases could remain inside a rejected unit, e.g. 'пластиковые окна в деревянном доме' inside WOOD_WINDOWS_COMMERCIAL.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The broad unit was unsafe and correctly rejected as a new product page, so the cluster-level verdict looked protective.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Rejecting a cluster/page idea does not mean every member has no valid destination; useful phrases can be silently stranded.
root_cause: Business-truth protection was applied at cluster level without a mandatory salvage pass for individual rows.
corrective_action: Systematically scan every NO_STANDALONE_PAGE/OUTSIDE candidate for in-scope salvageable phrases and reassign them through explicit correction rows.
verification_required: Salvage QA ledger shows all rejected/outside members reviewed; salvageable in-scope stranded rows = 0.
notes: Known example must be fixed but not used as the only search rule. | Closed only after V4 persistence/readback plus separate semantic acceptance; this does not imply Step12 final completion.

first_run_behavior: Narratives such as 'large stable task' relied partly on number of phrases in a unit.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: Many variants often signal a broad topic, so row count felt like a useful strength indicator.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Vocabulary size can be inflated by morphology, geo/price variants and acquisition mechanics; it does not measure real search demand.
corrective_action: Treat phrase count only as coverage/accounting. Join actual Wordstat/frequency/traffic evidence for demand claims and new-page decisions.
verification_required: No final demand-strength statement is supported only by phrase count; every such statement cites real demand evidence or is downgraded/removed.
notes: Closely linked to D12-03 but independently checked. | Closed/reclosed only after V5/V2 persisted readback and separate evidence acceptance; candidate page approval remains governed by later confidence/maturity.

first_run_behavior: Actions that still depended on later Step-13 conflict checks could remain HIGH/final-looking while only a boolean follow-up flag exposed the dependency.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: The roadmap boundary was respected and cannibalization itself was deferred, so the action seemed safe to state now.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: A provisional structure can look implementation-ready even though the next step may change it; uncertainty must be visible in the action itself.
root_cause: Step boundary was preserved procedurally but not reflected strongly enough in recommendation maturity.
corrective_action: Add recommendation maturity: FINAL_WITHIN_STEP12_EVIDENCE, PROVISIONAL_PENDING_STEP13_CONFLICT_CHECK, or DEFERRED_PENDING_MISSING_EVIDENCE. Confidence must reflect the dependency.
verification_required: Every action with a material unresolved downstream dependency is explicitly provisional/deferred; no such row is presented as final HIGH.
notes: These are maturity/status fields, not invented evidence routes.

first_run_behavior: Step 12 inherited OUTSIDE_SCOPE/NO_PAGE decisions even when full phrase review exposed member phrases that match verified existing site offers/pages, e.g. blinds and several glazing/window use-case phrases.
why_it_seemed_reasonable: Outside-scope states came from accepted upstream clustering/ownership and were therefore treated as frozen business truth.
why_it_is_insufficient_or_wrong: Later phrase-level evidence and the persisted site inventory can contradict an upstream outside-scope label. Blind inheritance strands valid demand and can hide an existing page that the site actually offers.
root_cause: Upstream status authority was treated as stronger than contradictory current phrase/site evidence instead of triggering an explicit correction overlay.
corrective_action: Re-audit every OUTSIDE_SCOPE and NO_STANDALONE member against the verified site inventory and current business scope; create explicit correction rows for in-scope salvageable phrases while preserving upstream history.
verification_required: All historical OUTSIDE/NO_PAGE phrases are accounted in a review ledger; any phrase contradicting verified site offer is reassigned or explicitly deferred; known blinds/open-balcony/panoramic-use-case contradictions are resolved; stranded verified-offer phrases = 0.
notes: Discovered during D12-01/D12-02 correction preparation; covered by the permanent salvage principle but tracked separately so this concrete failure cannot be lost. | Closed only after V4 persistence/readback plus separate semantic acceptance; this does not imply Step12 final completion.
